posts.author: Levthelion
posts.body:
Hello, my game is close to release, but I'm having a problem with text being displayed. Occasionally, part of the text will not exist. I tried reverting the font to standard, and turning off plugins that affect fonts, it still happened.
I believe it may have started when I updated nw.js so that steam achievements would work
If anyone knows why this happens and how to fix it, I would greatly appreciate it

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
when I do that, its works.
what is the version of NWJS and Pixi version you use?
you can use the console log.
just throw this into your console log and see what it prints out.
Code:
console.log(`NWJS Version: ${process.versions.nw}\nPIXI Version: ${PIXI.VERSION}`)
if that fails because of low nwjs version (default 0.29.0) than it may be that.
I use nwjs 0.48.4 with pixi version 4.8.9.
so you need to copy process.versions.nw and PIXI.VERSION alone and print out.
I can't replicate it or know the exact cause of it.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
higher version of NWJS doesn't matter as most use 0.49.2 or another
for greenworks steamachievements, some use a higher.
most that upgrade nwjs also update PIXI equally (4.8.9 mostly)
higher for MV may break (version 5 or better) but other got it to work.
so the issue wouldn't be there, but why it happen is also a riddle now.
as I can't replicate the issue you have, so I'm out of options really.
can be the graphic driver (if 2 of more, they can conflict) so choose a primary.
it may be due dual screen (can't tell) but some had issues on it too.
but if its both single graphic driver/screen, I have truly no idea.
